summary: Escalating multi-front tensions: IRGC fired ballistic missiles at two US warships prompting CENTCOM to disable three Iranian oil tankers; Hezbollah launched explosive drones at IDF in south Lebanon triggering Israeli retaliatory strikes; IDF raided Hamas cell in Aqqaba, West Bank, detaining 10 operatives.
key_points: IRGC fired ballistic missiles at two US warships; CENTCOM disabled MT DANI near Kharg, MT Stark 1 near Jask, and destroyed MT Kilo (Nakhson) in Gulf of Oman. (Source: @mamlekate/104339)
Hezbollah fired two explosive drones at IDF in south Lebanon security zone; IDF intercepted one and struck Hezbollah militants, infrastructure, and weapons warehouses. (Source: @idf_telegram/25061)
IDF/Yamam raid on Aqqaba, West Bank: 10 Hamas operatives detained, rocket without launcher, assault rifle, and large quantity of explosives seized and destroyed. (Source: @manniefabian/59106)
Three tankers (VELOS AMBER, BRAVO, AL SHEEHANIYA) including Qatari LNG received IRGC warnings in southern Strait of Hormuz and changed course. (Source: @SharghDaily/182166)
Israel destroyed historic house in Nabtaieh, southern Lebanon; Hezbollah assessed as attempting to drag Iran into confrontation around Ridge Ali Taher. (Source: @presstv/205717, @pkpoi/143852)
Fourth Iranian-linked tanker struck in Gulf of Oman in recent days, bringing total targeted to four vessels. (Source: @kianmeli1/91579)
IDF attacked Shati refugee camp in Gaza; destruction of Gaza sewage system knocked 5 of 6 Israeli desalination plants offline. (Source: @yediotnews25/134699, @presstv/205714)

sections.executive_summary: IRGC ballistic missile attacks on two US warships triggered CENTCOM retaliation that disabled three Iranian oil tankers (MT DANI near Kharg, MT Stark 1 near Jask, MT Kilo in Gulf of Oman). Hezbollah launched two explosive drones at IDF in south Lebanon; IDF intercepted one and struck Hezbollah infrastructure and weapons warehouses. IDF/Yamam raided Aqqaba in West Bank, detaining 10 Hamas operatives and seizing a rocket, assault rifle, and explosives.

sections.threat_assessment: The IRGC's ballistic missile attack on two US warships and CENTCOM's destruction of three Iranian tankers marks a significant escalation in the Gulf, raising risk of further Iranian retaliation against maritime targets. Hezbollah's drone attack on IDF forces in south Lebanon and Israeli retaliatory strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure indicate the northern front remains volatile, with Israeli assessments warning Hezbollah is attempting to draw Iran into direct confrontation around Ridge Ali Taher. The simultaneous IDF raid on a Hamas cell in Aqqaba and strike on Shati refugee camp in Gaza demonstrate continued multi-front operational tempo. The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical chokepoint with four Iranian-linked tankers already targeted, threatening global energy markets.
sections.regional_response: Saudi-led coalition conducted shelling and missile attacks in southwestern Yemen killing civilians including a child, while Yemeni government forces retook Hays District in Hodeidah from Houthis. US CENTCOM established a blockade enforcement posture around Iranian ports with refueling aircraft and fighters active near the Strait of Hormuz. Israel is conducting large-scale exercises with the 80th Division in Eilat/Arava simulating surprise attacks and multi-domain infiltration, indicating preparedness for broader conflict scenarios.
sections.intelligence_notes: The coordinated IRGC missile attack on US warships followed by CENTCOM tanker strikes suggests a tit-for-tat escalation dynamic in the Gulf that could spiral. Hezbollah's use of explosive drones against IDF in south Lebanon represents a tactical escalation beyond previous rocket exchanges. Location data exploitation of US forces in the Middle East (per Senator Wyden) indicates ongoing intelligence vulnerabilities. The Greek tanker Nimia's 45-day voyage from Yanbu versus 7 days pre-blockade quantifies the operational impact of Houthi maritime disruption on commercial shipping.
